slot.brief: Ask for the therapeutic class or target use of a well-known NCERT-listed drug (e.g. equanil, terfenadine, cimetidine); one correct classification among four options.

stem: Cimetidine is used mainly for which therapeutic purpose?
options: Relief of mild to moderate pain

verdicts.working: Cimetidine blocks H₂ receptors, reducing gastric acid secretion.

working:
Cimetidine blocks histamine H$_2$ receptors in the stomach wall.
This reduces gastric acid secretion and is used in treating peptic ulcers.
